description: Read Facebook Page posts and Instagram media with URLs, native periods and optional insights. These are content insights, not Ads Insights; do not infer an organic-only breakdown.

includeInsights.description: Include available insight metrics; additional provider permissions may be required.

includeInstagramMedia.description: Read related Instagram media when the token has permission.

includePagePosts.description: Read related Facebook Page posts when the token has permission.

limit.description: Maximum number of returned items or rows. The declared bounds and default apply; use pagination for additional results.

mediaIds.description: Specific Instagram media IDs to enrich.

pageId.description: Facebook Page ID for /posts and linked IG discovery.

postIds.description: Specific Facebook post IDs to enrich.

since.description: Optional Graph time filter. For IG media this should be Unix seconds or strtotime-compatible text.

until.description: Optional Graph time filter. For IG media this should be Unix seconds or strtotime-compatible text.

name: meta_get_organic_content_enrichment

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.
